sentiment.rationale: The document shows a strong quarter with net income of $15.0B and EPS of $5.24, but forward guidance is only modestly raised: NII ex. Markets guidance increased to ~$92B (from a prior implied level) and total NII to ~$95.5B, while adjusted expense guidance was raised to ~$95.5B primarily due to FX, which is largely bottom-line neutral. Management expresses cautious optimism, noting significant risks persist (tariffs, geopolitical, fiscal deficits). The guidance raise is partial and partly attributed to FX, limiting the positive signal.
